consumerConstruction.requestId: new non-empty identifier for every invocation and retry attempt
consumerConstruction.correlationId: copy the trusted current ExecutionContext correlation identifier
consumerConstruction.causationId: copy the trusted current ExecutionContext operation identifier
consumerConstruction.scopeActor: copy trusted scope and actor; never reconstruct from request payload
consumerConstruction.source: use the registered consumer adapter identity, never caller-supplied source

providerExecution.operationId: new non-empty identifier at the provider boundary
providerExecution.causationId: copy the validated inbound causation identifier
providerExecution.authorization: provider evaluates authorization from trusted local facts

carrierRule: in-process, HTTP and gRPC carriers must execute the same conformance suite without changing the consumer Application Port
realCarrierEvidence: required from Plan 01; fake carriers are not production migration evidence
